frequency_question: How often do proposed fee increases of >500% for major visa categories reach finalization within one year of proposal?
membership_rule: Includes rulemakings proposing fee hikes exceeding 500% for major visa categories (H, L, or O visas). Excludes routine inflation adjustments.
coverage_note: These represent the most significant recent attempts to alter the fee structure for high-volume visa programs.
known_gaps: Limited sample size due to the rarity of extreme (non-inflationary) fee hikes.
skeleton: Total major immigration fee restructuring proposals vs. those finalized with extreme hikes.
multiplier: 3 total cases identified; 2 were finalized fee hikes, 1 was a failed regulatory attempt.
validity_reason: The rate is specific to the current administrative cycle and the political appetite for immigration fee reform.
